nodes.description: Public string state variable holding the token name ("myCryptoWallet").
Public string state variable holding the token symbol ("MCW").
Public uint state variable holding the token decimals (10).
Public uint state variable holding the total token supply; mutated by burn and initialized in the constructor.
Public address state variable storing the privileged founder/owner address set from msg.sender.
Public mapping(address => uint) tracking token balances; read and mutated by balanceOf, transfer and burn.
Constructor that mints the initial supply, assigns founder = msg.sender and credits balances[founder].
View function returning the current value of the supply state variable.
View function returning balances[tokenOwner] into the named return variable balance.
Public transfer function: requires balances[msg.sender] >= tokens && tokens > 0, then credits balances[to], debits balances[msg.sender] and emits Transfer.
Public burn function: requires balances[founder] >= _value, then decrements both balances[founder] and supply.
Caller-controlled address; used as founder in the constructor and as the source account in transfer.
Unchecked addition crediting the recipient balance inside transfer (uint overflow risk).
Unchecked subtraction debiting the caller balance inside transfer (uint underflow risk if invariant broken).
Unchecked subtraction from the founder balance inside burn (arithmetic risk).
Unchecked subtraction from total supply inside burn (arithmetic risk).
Privileged ownership assignment in the constructor taking the caller address directly from untrusted input.
Address parameter of balanceOf used as the lookup key into balances.
Recipient address parameter of transfer used as the destination key of the balances mapping.
Amount parameter of transfer used in the balance check and in both balance mutations.
Amount parameter of burn used in the founder balance check and in the balance/supply mutations.
Named return variable of balanceOf populated with balances[tokenOwner].

edges.reason: msg.sender is used to look up balances[msg.sender] in the require check that authorizes the transfer.
Untrusted caller address is the mapping key whose balance is decremented by an unguarded subtraction.
founder is set directly from msg.sender in the constructor, granting privileged ownership to the caller.
Parameter tokens flows into the unchecked addition of the recipient balance.
Parameter tokens flows into the unchecked subtraction of the caller balance.
Parameter to selects the destination slot of the balances mapping that is credited.
Parameter _value flows into the unchecked subtraction of the founder balance.
Parameter _value flows into the unchecked subtraction of the total supply.
Parameter tokenOwner is used as the key read from the balances mapping inside balanceOf.
Named return variable balance is assigned the result of balances[tokenOwner] in balanceOf.
State variable supply is read and returned by totalSupply.
State mapping balances is read by balanceOf.
State mapping balances is both read (check) and written (credit/debit) inside transfer.
State mapping balances is read (check) and written (decrement) inside burn.
State variable founder is used as the mapping key burned from in burn.
After the require guard passes, transfer executes the recipient credit operation.
Sequential execution: the recipient credit is followed by the caller debit in transfer.
After the require guard passes, burn executes the founder balance decrement.
Sequential execution: the founder balance decrement is followed by the supply decrement in burn.
Constructor execution path performs the privileged founder = msg.sender assignment.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter tokenOwner is only a lookup key local to balanceOf and carries no independent state; fold it into the balanceOf function node.
Parameter to is only a destination key used by transfer; fold it into the transfer function node.
Parameter tokens is scoped exclusively to transfer and is consumed by its balance mutations; fold it into the transfer function node.
Parameter _value is scoped exclusively to burn and drives its balance/supply mutations; fold it into the burn function node.
Local named return variable balance is a temporary read result of balanceOf with no standalone semantics; fold it into the balanceOf function node.
